integrity: The result relies on a complete finite integer-exact acyclic discrete-Morse verification with independent polynomial/girth cross-check; the complete verifier sources are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Applies exactly to the 28-vertex Coxeter graph constructed from the non-lines of a seven-point Fano plane; no family-wide or equivariant extension is claimed. Residual risk of equivalent unindexed literature remains.
title: The Coxeter graph independence complex is \(\bigvee^{7}S^{6}\)
